answer.headline: A tracking issue on Macintosh emerged, causing purchases without checkout to spike.
explanation: Measurement health flagged an issue for operating system Macintosh starting on Fri 11 Dec 2020 where purchases without checkout surged to {F7}.
This tracking anomaly affects our checkout progression metrics and coincides with a sharp drop in checkout starts on this segment.
answer.next_step: Inspect the checkout event tags and scripts deployed on Macintosh devices.
